funding_methodology.status: partial realized funding; full snapshot estimates descriptive only
funding_methodology.units: Decimal hourly rate; sum = USD per constant oracle-valued USD1 notional; positive long pays. No second division by8. Not account cashflow.
funding_methodology.timing_caveat: Snapshot received_at is request-start, not true response receipt; no precision/no-lookahead availability certification. Estimator uses labeled strict pre-hour age<=360s. All selected snapshots precede acquisition cutoff by >9 hours.
funding_methodology.weekly_method: Deduplicate asset/timestamp; conflicting duplicates become missing. Carry nonnull rate to min(next observation,t+300s); split at regular-equity boundaries. Mean=sum(rate*observed seconds)/observed seconds; observed_rate_integral=sum(rate*seconds)/3600 is not settled funding.

weekly_window.calendar_note: Oct5-9 five regular 09:30-16:00 ET sessions; no holidays/early close. Oct12 regular equity day despite federal holiday, outside weekly window. Premarket/after-hours are closed relative to regular equities only.
